title: Preparer Opposition and Strategic Implementation of Governmental Accounting Standards: Evidence from Public Pension Accounting Reform
eligible_reason: Not a staggered adoption. GASB Statements 67/68 apply to all plans from the first fiscal year beginning after 15 June 2013, coded post = 1(fye >= 16 Jun 2014) (Code/1. variable construct.sas lines 30-32). Treatment is post x oppose, where oppose is a time-invariant indicator for plans whose state opposed the market-based discount rate. In fiscal-year terms every plan switches on in FY2014. Calendar first-treated dates differ only by fiscal-year-end convention: 84 of 111 plans first treated at 30 Jun 2014, the rest Aug/Sep/Dec 2014 or 2015. Time FE are i.fye at the exact fiscal-year-end date, so each fiscal-year-end group has its own time cells and plans are compared only with plans sharing their adoption date. That is the adoption-cohort x time case ruled stacked in PROTOCOL 5b. Every column also includes time-varying controls amort_uaal and fund_ratio. Table 7 col 1 is pooled OLS.
design_notes: Code/6. main results.do lines 59-90 (Table 7: col 1 reg with post, oppose, post_oppose; cols 2-3 areg with ppd_id FE and i.fye; col 4 event study oppose_govt_d2011-d2017), lines 100-170 (Table 8 Panels A-B: asset allocation, contribution rates, plan closures, benefit cuts on post_oppose_govt and post_oppose_fund). Datasets/sample_t7t8a.dta: 819 plan-years, 114 plans (86 oppose), fiscal years ending 2010-2017. Tables 1-6 analyse GASB comment letters cross-sectionally.
n_eligible_specs_note: Single policy date in fiscal time; fiscal-year-end-date FE separate cohorts; time-varying controls in all columns.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One fiscal-year adoption (FY2014). Calendar first-post fye: 30 Jun 2014 (84 plans), 31 Aug 2014 (3), 30 Sep 2014 (4), 31 Dec 2014 (2), 31 Mar 2015 (2), 30 Jun 2015 (4), 31 Dec 2015 (11, mostly because the 2014 December observation is missing), 30 Jun 2016 (1).
data_access: public (Public Plans Data, Census) plus hand-collected state data
software_notes: Stata areg/reg for results; SAS for sample construction.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). FLAG FOR LEAD: if fiscal-year-end variation is read as staggered adoption, the paper becomes a near-miss, because amort_uaal and fund_ratio enter every column. I read it as a single policy date, because the fye-date FE make the comparisons within fiscal-year-end cohort.
